title: Vosse - Manufacturer of steel structures and elements
description: Producent elementów i lekkich konstrukcji stalowych. Specjalizujemy się w wytwarzaniu i obróbce komponentów stalowych oraz urządzeń i maszyn stalowych.

Downloads Career Material warehouse Realizations Laser cutting CNC metal sheet bending For industry and energy For construction For shipbuilding Prefabrication Services Bevelling of edges Structure welding Other services Transport and loading Products with the CE mark Contact Make an enquiry Steel components and structures You design, we create We are a manufacturer of steel elements and light structures. We specialise in production and machining of steel components and assembly of structures based on steel solutions, including steel machines and equipment. OPENING HOURS Monday - Friday 08.00 - 15.00 PHONE NUMBER T: +48 533 150 100 | +48 885 200 226 E-MAIL ADDRESS biuro@vosse.com CONTACT WELCOME TO WEBSITE OF VOSSE A renowned manufacturer of steel components and light structures FOR THE INDUSTRY AND ENERGY SECTOR We manufacture steel structures for the purposes of industrial facilities as well as machines and equipment which structure is based on steel solutions. FOR THE CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY We manufacture steel elements for the purposes of structures of manufacturing halls, sheds and other non-residential construction facilities , and metal elements of interior furnishings and finishing. FOR THE SHIPBUILDING INDUSTRY We manufacture elements of ships, yachts, drilling platforms and other steel structures for the purposes of the offshore and onshore industries. PREFABRICATION AND COMPONENTS We specialise in carrying out serial orders for steel components, guaranteeing at the same time their full repeatability. We also deal with prefabrication of steel elements and structures. PROFESSIONALISM Vosse is an answer to the needs of customers looking for a company which guarantees satisfaction with quality of rendered services. Quality supported most of all by many years of experience in the industry of manufacturing steel structures and components. SERVICE Our customer service and production preparation departments have the current knowledge of individual stages of production thanks to which customers may at any time receive full information on their order. QUALITY What distinguishes us compared to the competition is quality. We operate on the basis of ISO 9001 Certified Quality Management System, we have EN 10910-1 Certificate of Conformity of Factory Production Control and we meet quality requirements concerning steel structure welding according to PN-EN ISO 3834-2 certificate. TRANSPORT We take care steel structures and elements manufactured by us reach our customer intact. Consequently, we not only carefully pack them, but also take care they are thoroughly protected for the duration of transport. WHAT WE DO ? Vosse specialises most of all in manufacturing light steel structures in average and large series, prefabrication and manufacturing steel components. See the gallery of our orders completed to date. REALIZATIONS WHAT DO WE GUARANTEE ? In Vosse we are aware of the enormous significance of even the smallest elements of fulfilment of an order. We make every effort to plan every stage to ensure finished products are delivered to a customer within a set period. VALUATION We make valuations for requests for quotation concerning production of both steel elements and light structures in the shortest time possible, usually within several hours. CONTACT We immediately respond to all questions concerning an order. SPECIALISATION 30 years of experience related to steel processing weighs in our favour, we also have numerous certificates of steel component and structure welding and production quality management. DELIVERY We ensure the possibility of transport by road and sea. CONTACT US Name and surname Subject E-mail address Phone number Kategoria zapytania Quotation of a project Place a new order Inquiry about the order being processed Complaint Other query Message Send FACTS NUMBERS SPEAK FOR THEMSELVES 0 CUSTOMERS FROM THROUGHOUT THE WORLD A broad group of customers from Poland and other countries of Europe, and beyond the borders of the old continent have already trusted us. It means that our steel structures and elements made of steel feature high quality of workmanship that meets growing demands of customers across the world. 0 TEAM OF EXPERIENCED EMPLOYEES Our team is a highly qualified group of people who every day take care customers receive products consistent with their expectations. Regular control of manufacturing processes and continuous contact with customers ensures seamless fulfilment of orders, while the experience of our employees allows to promptly deliver finished products. 0 PRODUCTION AREA It houses our main machinery park, equipped among others with saws, milling machines, welding machines or cutters. In turn, a crane located in the hall may lift steel structures with the weight up to 8 tons. However, that is not everything... We also have a production hall with the area of 800m2, warehouses, sheds and a manoeuvring yard. 0 YEARS OF EXPERIENCE Vosse continues many years of history of Wandtke Grupa. The company is constantly developing, we invest both in new technological solutions and staff. Our production is based on Certified Quality Management Systems due to which we guarantee reliable and proper fulfilment of orders in the field of manufacturing steel light structure and components. IS YOUR PROJECT AWAITING FULFILMENT? Send it to us and check how advantageous our offer will be! CONTACT US VOSSE The company was built on over 30 years of experience of Wandtke Grupa. Many years of practice in manufacturing light steel structures and components for vehicles makes us stand out from the competition. The pillar of our company is a specialised team of employees and a constantly growing and modernised machinery park.
